title: Day 13: The Entry Is In. The Agents Kept Building After the Recording
summary: I recorded the demo and submitted the contest entry, explaining it as a coordination layer on top of Git. After the recording, I asked agents to fix the remaining problems, and they added a watcher and early warnings for planned files. Both are reviewed but not yet on Cloudflare.
author: Alexey Grigorev
